response.justification: Technically the candidate exceeds every requirement — 15+ years of fullstack work with TypeScript/Node, React, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and strong architecture/testing discipline — and is already based in Berlin, which satisfies the on-site requirement. The mismatch is seniority: this is an entry-level individual contributor posting, and a Staff/Senior engineer with a founder background is very likely to be misaligned on compensation, scope, and long-term retention. Worth a screening call only if the team is open to hiring above the advertised level or the candidate has explicitly signaled interest in a step down; otherwise the role is unlikely to hold their interest.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node + React fullstack experience across many production systems
Strong nice-to-have coverage: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, AI-agent tooling
Berlin-based, fits high on-site requirement; fluent English, long tenure history
concerns: Significantly overqualified for an entry-level posting; likely salary/scope mismatch
No PostgreSQL or Nest.js evidence (MongoDB/MySQL-heavy background)
Retention risk — may disengage or leave once a senior-level offer appears

key_factors.factor: Core stack and nice-to-have skill match
